The drive by the preservationists to create greater and greater areas of wilderness on all the publicly owned lands is excluding tens of millions of people
from enjoying these lands. If less of these lands were made into wilderness
areas and note areas were opened to roads, there could be fewer problems with
the use of off-road vericles.
We respectfully request these cornerts be considered in development of environmental statements.
Very sincerely yours,
WYONING-UTATI-NEVADA CHAPTER OUTLOOFS UNLIMITED, INC.
Joel L. Frykman, President
